jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

carloans 365 is a fast\-growing, industry\-leading car finance broker based in Sale, just 10 minutes from Manchester City Centre.

Our mission is simple: to empower our customers by securing the best finance deals tailored to their needs, helping them drive away in their perfect car. With rapid growth and a reputation for delivering exceptional customer service, we pride ourselves on making car finance quick, easy and hassle\-free. Join us at carloans 365, where customer satisfaction drives our success.

**ENOUGH ABOUT US, WHAT'S THE ROLE?**

Technology is central to the next stage of our growth. We're building and improving bespoke internal platforms, customer and operational tools, CRM and telephony integrations, automation, AI\-enabled services and data solutions that support teams across the business.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who can take genuine ownership of software from idea to production. You'll work closely with our Head of Technical Operations and senior stakeholders to understand what the business needs, turn those requirements into well\-designed technical solutions, and then build, test, deploy and continuously improve them. This is a hands\-on role for someone equally comfortable creating intuitive front\-end experiences and building the back\-end services, databases, APIs and integrations behind them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Designing, building and owning bespoke web applications, internal platforms, tools and services from initial requirement and technical design through to production deployment and ongoing improvement
* Building responsive, accessible and intuitive front\-end applications using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices
* Designing and developing robust back\-end services, business logic and APIs using modern server\-side technologies such as Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, Python or equivalent
* Designing, querying and optimising relational databases, including SQL data models and reliable data flows between systems
* Creating secure integrations between internal applications and third\-party platforms including CRM, telephony, AI services, lenders, reporting tools and other business systems
* Working directly with operational teams and senior stakeholders to understand problems, challenge requirements where appropriate and translate them into practical technical solutions
* Owning the full software development lifecycle including scoping, architecture, development, code review, testing, deployment, monitoring, support and iteration
* Building reusable components, services and integration patterns that provide a scalable technical foundation for future growth
* Building security, privacy and auditability into applications from the outset, including authentication, role\-based access, logging and secure handling of customer and commercially sensitive data
* Mentoring less experienced developers or technical team members and helping establish strong engineering practices across the team

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Strong commercial full\-stack software engineering experience, with evidence of personally delivering production software across both front\-end and back\-end development
* Strong React experience together with modern JavaScript and/or TypeScript, HTML and CSS
* Strong back\-end development experience with a modern technology such as Node.js/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, Python or equivalent
* Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema design, querying, performance considerations and data integrity
* Experience designing, building and consuming REST APIs and integrating multiple third\-party systems
* Experience taking software from requirements through architecture, build, automated testing, deployment and ongoing production support
* Strong Git/version\-control practices, including branching, pull requests and code review, together with experience of automated testing
* Experience deploying and operating applications in a cloud environment such as Azure, AWS or equivalent, including CI/CD, monitoring and secure software development practices

**Working Style \& Mindset**

* Ownership mindset: comfortable being responsible for a solution end to end rather than only one layer of the stack
* Commercially minded: able to understand the operational problem behind a request and build the solution that creates the most value
* Pragmatic problem\-solver: able to move quickly without sacrificing security, reliability or maintainability
* Confident communicator: able to explain technical decisions, risks and trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Self\-directed and proactive: comfortable working in a growing technical function where not every requirement will arrive perfectly defined
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, FCA\-regulated environment where data quality, customer outcomes, controls and auditability matter

**Desirable (but not required)**

* Experience building software within financial services, fintech, motor finance, insurance or another regulated environment
* Experience with contact\-centre or telephony platforms such as ConnexAI, Twilio, Five9 or similar
* Experience with Azure/AWS, CI/CD, Docker or modern application hosting patterns
* Practical experience integrating AI/LLM services, CRM platforms, real\-time systems, queues, webhooks or event\-driven architecture

**WHAT THE ROLE ISN’T**

This isn't a front\-end\-only, back\-end\-only or systems\-administration role. We need someone who can understand a business problem and build the complete solution around it. You'll be expected to work across the application, database, API and integration layers, take responsibility for what happens after deployment, ask the right questions and help us decide the best way to build solutions around how carloans 365 actually operates.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Genuine ownership of products and systems that have a direct impact on how the business operates
* Opportunity to build bespoke technology rather than simply maintain legacy or off\-the\-shelf systems
* Direct exposure to senior decision\-making and the ability to influence technical direction and architecture
* A varied engineering environment spanning customer journeys, internal operations, CRM, telephony, AI, automation and data
* Opportunity to help establish engineering standards and shape the technical team as the business continues to grow

**DETAILS**

* £70,000 \- £80,000 per annum (DOE)
* Working pattern: 09:00 – 18:00, 5 days per week, Monday – Friday
* 28 days holiday (bank holidays are normal working days) \+ 1 additional day off for your birthday

**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**

* Bupa Private Medical Insurance: access to private healthcare through our company Bupa scheme
* Employee Car Scheme: access to our exclusive employee car scheme
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): confidential support and guidance when you need it
* Company Events

Pay: £70,000\.00\-£80,000\.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Sale M33 7RR: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Public Health Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

Are you a highly motivated multi\-disciplinary engineer looking to work on building projects that can change the world, projects that are always more complex and innovative than the last?


We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineer to join our MEP team. This is a hybrid role and you could be based in our London, Croydon, St.Albans, Manchester, Leeds, Exeter, Cardiff or Bristol office to work across a broad range of sectors and for a broad range of clients. You will be joining a team of like\-minded experts that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.

 **About Us:**

AECOM plays a critical role in the conceptualisation and creation of amazing spaces, delivering projects and buildings that define skylines and communities. AECOM Buildings \& Places – Design is made up of dedicated teams delivering projects in Commercial, Residential, Hospitality, Sports Venues, Work Places, Data Centres, Education, Government, Healthcare and Defence.


We are friendly, busy and motivated with an established track record of successfully delivering local and overseas projects. Some of our flagship work in recent years include:

* **Healthcare**: AECOM is a leading award\-winning consultant for the NHS in the UK and internationally, delivering projects ranging from major acute hospitals to primary care and estate refurbishment schemes, while supporting the NHS Net Zero Carbon agenda.
* **Decarbonisation**: Multiple projects where we have undertaken the feasibility of the removal of boilers and installation of Air Source and Water source heat pumps to provide the heating and cooling for the building. Projects include commercial buildings like 80 – 100 Victoria Street London, British Library, multiple residential buildings in the Royal Borough of Greenwich and even Windsor Castle.
* **Stratford Cross**: A major mixed\-use regeneration development in Stratford, East London, located within the former Olympic Park area. Our team are providing multi\-discipline services including MEP, civil \& structural, vertical transportation, energy \& sustainability, acoustics, air quality, ecology, transport, waste management, and façade engineering.
* **Data Centres**: Working for multiple major hyperscale projects in the Nordics, Iberia and South America. These projects provide the opportunity to tackle the issue of data management and storage specific to each country. Designing and implementing a highly resilient electrical infrastructure entails the usage of an efficient system that is highly sustainable.
* **Lansdowne House**: High\-end commercial office development occupying the South\-East side of Berkley Square, Mayfair, City of Westminster, with an all\- electric energy centre containing Ground Source Heat Pumps, Air Source Heat Pumps and High Efficiency Chillers.
* **10 Dock:** Western Europe’s largest naval dockyard in Plymouth, a defence project of enormous scale and multiple components that must come together as a solution to meet a new capability.

 **About Our Team:**


Our award\-winning and close\-knit Building Services team have a strong presence across sectors and we have and a strong Public Health engineering team throughout the UK. The team is seeking to expand their capabilities further by adding a Senior Public Health Engineer with experience in delivering sustainable projects across multiple sectors, has excellent team working and co\-ordination skills and strives for technical excellence.


You will be an integral part of the diverse and dynamic national AECOM PH team which will support your technical career development. Challenges such as the net zero agenda and water neutrality provide great opportunities for your career to flourish with the role also including Fire Protection systems design which will be supported by our experienced specialist fire protection engineering team to provide the opportunity to develop new design skills. The position is predominantly office located role to ensure face\-to\-face contact time with the team.


The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading much of the Public Health and Fire Protection systems design on projects and involve client liaison, mentoring and leading the discipline/systems to prepare scheme and detailed engineering designs. The successful candidate will have proven design experience, delivering to quality, time and budget. This role will suit someone with who is enthusiastic, self\-motivated, and looking to advance their career.

  

The role will include taking point lead on multiple PH systems design/calculations on a project as well as assisting the lead PH engineer with experience in the following systems:

* Hot and cold water systems
* Above ground foul and rainwater system
* Fire Protection Systems
* Below Ground drainage systems
* Pumped drainage systems
* Water and oil leak detection systems
* Rainwater harvesting and Greywater recycling systems
* Water conservation solutions
* BREEAM, LEED and Ska Rating design integration


Duties of the role will include, but not be limited to;

* Maintaining Client relationships
* Mentoring and developing staff
* Project Managing small sized multi\-disciplinary projects
* Obtain the necessary information both internally and externally from Architects, Quantity Surveyors and Design Consultants to provide a fully coordinated design
* Ensure the Design Team is kept fully informed of all technical and other information necessary for the duration of the project
* Be familiar with the BIM design process and be capable of input and support for projects designed in Revit
* Ensure compliance with all Statutory and Regulatory obligations, make submissions to the Statutory Authorities and obtain approvals as necessary
* Produce all design information and ensure that all calculations are prepared and signed off in accordance with the requirements of the QA procedures, relevant Standards and Codes of Practice
* Represent AECOM at Client, Design Team and Progress meetings throughout the design and construction phases of projects
* Support AECOM PM with input to pre\-qualification and selection of contractors, also respond to tender queries, comment and review tender returns
* Ensure the project work complies with the Project Management Plan and Programme
* Understand and implement AECOM’s Safety Health and Environment Policy

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Previous public health engineering work experience within design consultancy or other relevant business
* A comprehensive working knowledge of statutory regulations to ensure design compliance, make submissions to the statutory authorities and obtaining approvals as necessary
* Be able to work independently and have good time/task management skills
* Experience in mixed used, residential, commercial and healthcare buildings/sectors
* Fully competent in the use of AutoCad to produce 2D drawings
* Fully competence in using 3D Revit software and Navisworks reviewing software
* Ability to speak fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations

 **Qualifications**  

* Chartered Engineer with CIBSE / IET / IMechE (or working towards)
* BEng for a relevant engineering course (MEng preferred)
* CIBSE SoPHE Member

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

**Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity**


You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.


You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.


AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.


Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.


We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
